calculate_bbox_iou: calculate intersection over union (IoU) between two sets of bounding boxes using bbox_overlaps
calculate_bbox_giou: calculate generalized intersection over union (GIoU) between two sets of bounding boxes using bbox_overlaps with mode giou
calculate_bbox_iof: calculate intersection over foreground (IoF) between two sets of bounding boxes using bbox_overlaps with mode iof
calculate_aligned_bbox_overlaps: calculate overlaps between aligned pairs of bounding boxes using bbox_overlaps with is_aligned set to True
clamp_fp16_tensor: clamp a float16 tensor values between min and max using fp16_clamp with CPU fallback support
